(2)  Notwithstanding  the  death,  removal
from office or resignation of the Prime Minister,
during  the  period  intervening  between  the
dissolution  of  Parliament  and  the  conclusion
of  the  General  Election,  the  Cabinet  of
Ministers  shall  continue  to  function  with  the
other Ministers of the Cabinet of Ministers as
its  members,  until  the  conclusion  of  the
General Election. The President may appoint
one  such  Minister  to  exercise,  perform  and
discharge the powers, duties and functions of
the Prime Minister.
(3)  On  the  death,  removal  from  office  or
resignation,  during  the  period  intervening
between the dissolution of Parliament and the
conclusion of the General Election, of a Minister
of the Cabinet of Ministers, the President may,
on  the  advice  of  the  Prime  Minister,  appoint
any other Minister to be the Minister in charge
of the Ministry of such Minister or to exercise,
perform and discharge the powers, duties and
functions of such Minister.
